{{Quote|We won't be able to hold them back!|This Weequay to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>}}
This '''Weequay''' was part of the security personnel for the [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] wanted to capture [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] attempted to take Palpatine to safety, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] caught up to them on a [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev]] train, where this [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] was working as part of the security personnel. The Weequay told Windu that they could not fight against Grievous and his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Windu told the Weequay to open the door of the mag-lev train, which allowed him and Fisto to get to the rear car, and defend against the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
